claims.summary: For binary matrices A of shape m by n and B of shape n by m, m>n>=1, P=product_(i,j)(1+delta_ij+(AB)_ij) has exact Boolean ideal order m-n+1: P is in I^(m-n+1) but not I^(m-n+2), I generated by all entry Boolean axioms. An explicit Boolean rank-(n-1) point realizes the minimum local order. Every fixed-point leading form is a product of degree-at-most-two forms with a small constant-depth circuit; cheap Koszul changes prevent requiring every residual-certificate coefficient to have the corresponding deep ideal order. No circuit-size or original PC-degree lower bound is inferred.
claims.assessment: Working all-parameter rank-defect, idempotent partial-permutation and comaximal-power proof, passed by the sole staged medium reviewer with notation corrections. Sharpness includes n=1; n=0 and m<=n are expressly excluded. The result supplies a concrete Boolean thickening, not hardness of full correction circuits.
claims.rationale: Identifies an exact geometric quantity for the existing rank family and simultaneously rules out mistaking its single-point leading forms or arbitrary coefficient depths for circuit hardness.
claims.next_action: Test the complete correction tuple on the fixed m=2n family via an explicitly shared pivot/gluing construction; deep ideal membership is an optional construction device, not a necessary lower-bound premise.

claims.summary: Replacing scalar oracle gates for Boolean-zero polynomials by zero preserves the Boolean function of any F2 sum/product circuit with binary constants, with no larger size/depth, including nested calls. Thus no uniformly fixed-depth poly(r)-size F2 scalar-oracle closure for all nonzero members of r-minor ideals can output det_floor(r^(1/3)) or any Frobenius power: use det_r(X)(x_11^2+x_11) and the recorded determinant-function bound. Moreover every complete linear Q(x,Z) with Q(x,b)=P for the binary rank residual is Boolean-zero: P in I^2 forces q_j(a)=partial_j P(a)=0. The obstruction covers black-box binary scalar extraction, not white-box transformations or extension-field circuits.
claims.assessment: Working elementary oracle-elimination corollary of the recorded Smolensky-based determinant-function reduction, passed by the same staged reviewer including the actual residual-certificate application. It does not contradict Dey-Guo/Andrews-Forbes large-field results or exclude their small-characteristic large-field extensions.
claims.rationale: Exposes the field-model obstruction in a tempting determinantal-ideal import and applies it to the entire actual linear correction-certificate class, without promoting it to an IPS lower bound.
claims.next_action: Keep any proposed extraction explicit about binary scalar versus extension-field arguments and black-box versus white-box access; pursue the full correction tuple with the scheduled pivot/gluing test.
